pages.title: Basic Math in Python
pages.content: Python supports all common math operations: `+` (add), `-` (subtract), `*` (multiply), `/` (divide), `**` (power), `//` (floor division), and `%` (modulo).

pages.title: Operators in Action
pages.content: Here are all the arithmetic operators:
pages.code:
print(10 + 3)   # 13  (addition)
print(10 - 3)   # 7   (subtraction)
print(10 * 3)   # 30  (multiplication)
print(10 / 3)   # 3.33 (division)
print(10 ** 2)  # 100 (power)
print(10 // 3)  # 3   (floor division)
print(10 % 3)   # 1   (modulo/remainder)

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: What does `10 % 3` return?
pages.explanation: The modulo operator % returns the remainder: 10 divided by 3 = 3 remainder 1.

pages.title: Floor Division
pages.text: The operator [blank] performs floor division in Python.
